comment: The architecture rule set, classified. The machine-readable form of
docs/ARCH_RULES.md, and the input a future gate reads.
TIERS
A  the rule catches a defect and is cheap: it reads a graph, IL
or a declaration, so a refactor that keeps the invariant does
not fire it.
B  the rule catches a defect but nags: it reads text, or binds to
a file, a line or a name, so a legitimate change can fire it.
C  the rule catches the tree's SHAPE: it is a census, a ratchet or
a baseline. It claims no defect; it holds a number.
VERDICT
defect    the subject is an invariant that was broken once.
refactor  the subject is a shape that a legitimate change moves.
shape     the rule measures; neither of the two.
FALSE-POSITIVE COST
low      a refactor that keeps the invariant cannot fire it.
medium   a refactor can fire it, but only by moving a declaration.
high     it binds to the TEXT of a file, so a reformat fires it.
EVIDENCE
The firings a guard was classified from, when the triage registry
(tools/guard-triage-classes.json) has any. A guard with no
evidence has not fired yet, and its tier is a reading of its
source, not a measurement. That is the limit of this file.
